scripts.dev: npm run build -w @psa/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @psa/contracts && npm run build -w @psa/api && npm run build -w @psa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @psa/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @psa/api && npm run typecheck -w @psa/web
